type: SOURCE-ONLY INITIAL-STATE AND PURPOSE READBACK; no model trajectory or output read
timing: Compiled after profile launch from the already frozen source corpus only; no outcome-based case selection or new registered claim.
conceptual_readback: Cross ownership of two action arguments is not proof that two new beneficial transfers are needed. Some Give recipients already own the item at the start; a fresh Give event and an already-true delivery relation are different measurements.

Initial recipient custody is not evidence that this NPC previously gifted the item or fulfilled a promise. It establishes only an already-true present possession relation; historical Give and new useful cooperation remain distinct.

All authored Drop targets in this cross cohort begin with the other character, so the speaker already does not hold that source object. For explicit free-hand/remove-sword/hat-off subconditions, retrieving it merely to drop it would recreate an already-absent burden. This does not prove a potion, exorcism, seat reservation, bird observation or alliance is complete.

Some Steal motivations are covert reclaiming, taking enemy arms, revenge, poisoning or cult information gathering. A CPU path that lets both original atomic actions occur is not a common-purpose or mutual-benefit label.

The original separate authors supplied personas, motives, timelines and action targets on a shared static graph. The composed dual-role task keeps those facts, including tensions and already-true relations; it is not an author-tested simultaneous cooperative quest.
Every one of the 32 source pairs remains in evaluation. Unknown target IDs stay unknown; no missing action, failure or success label is inferred from an unobservable higher-purpose story.
